first_acquisition: Disposable genuine original Normal Reimu A credit, hands-off after the initial seven-control qualification. All subsequent X input belongs to the four-head learned policy only in separately registered credits.
confirmed_distinct_native_resources: 2 spare players / 3 Bombs initially; confirmed X once costs one Bomb, first two subsequent ordinary deaths reduce spare stock and refill Bombs, final active life opens the original Continue screen. Default selection is No. No continue input was requested.
shooting_evidence: The control montage shows the unmodified play area empty directly above Reimu before Z, the newly spawned Reimu projectile when Z is held, and the original Bomb spell overlay after X.
